title: gp-quantum-bottleneck-unet: Source code for global versus patch-wise quantum bottlenecks in U-Net mammographic mass segmentation
description: Code, data tables and per-image results for the study 'Simulated Quantum Bottlenecks in U-Net Mammographic Mass Segmentation: No Detected Dice Benefit and Training-Dependent Encoding Effects'. A simulated 4-qubit circuit is placed globally or patch-wise in a U-Net bottleneck and compared with a same-size classical Dense(4) layer and an identity mapping in the same slot. Models are trained on randomized CBIS-DDSM mass ROI crops (patient-level five-fold cross-validation, three seeds, two learning-rate schedules, 190 runs) and tested without fine-tuning on DMID. The release contains the preprocessing, training, evaluation, code-replacement and statistics code, the patient-level folds and crop parameters, the DMID reference assignment records, and the per-image results of all runs. No images are included.
